data.gender_notes: Abba is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Abba is recorded in name-lists as “Father”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Abba expresses “Father”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abba total 6, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

in_hebrew.name: אבא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אבא הוא מילה עברית שמשמעותה אבא, אבי, או אבא האהוב, המופיעה בברית החדשה ככינוי לאלוהים, ומדגישה את היחס האישי והאהוב בין האל לבניו

in_greek.name: Ἀββά
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἀββά ἐστιν ἡ Ἑβραϊκή λέξις ἀβ्बᾶ, πατήρ, ἡ ὀποία ἐν τῇ Καινῇ Διαθήκῃ ὑποδηλοῖ τὴν πατρικὴν σχέσιν καὶ ἀγάπην τοῦ Θεοῦ πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ

in_latin.name: Abba
in_latin.long_meaning: Abba est verbum Hebraicum, quod significat patrem, et in Novo Testamento apparet ut nomen Dei, quod exprimit relationem personalem et amorem Dei erga filios suos, et habet magnam significationem in traditione christiana
